mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_audit_log (audit_id, tenant_id, actor, action, module, target, trace_id, success, occurred_at) VALUES (#{auditId}, #{tenantId}, #{actor}, #{action}, #{module}, #{target}, #{traceId}, #{success}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT audit_id, tenant_id, actor, action, module, target, trace_id, success, occurred_at FROM iam_audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
SELECT audit_id, tenant_id, actor, action, module, target, trace_id, success, occurred_at FROM iam_audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND module = #{module} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
SELECT audit_id, tenant_id, actor, action, module, target, trace_id, success, occurred_at FROM iam_audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND actor = #{actor} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
